entries.title: Getting started
entries.summary: Your quick reference for races, skills and equipment.

sections.title: Open the guide
lines: Press F8 in the world, or use Guide on the Tensura status screen or the guide button in the pause menu. The key can be changed in Controls.

sections.title: Find what you need
lines: Search by name, ability, damage type or requirement. Categories narrow the results. Scroll each panel independently; use the arrows to return to earlier pages. Ctrl+F focuses search.

sections.title: Read the numbers
lines: Values are defaults. Server settings, mastery and other bonuses can change them. Skill pages list the damage type; support moves do not deal damage.

entries.title: Heavenly Restriction lineage
entries.summary: Choose Fettered Human at reincarnation. Difficulty: Hard. The lineage keeps your human appearance.

sections.title: Starting resources
lines: 1,500–2,000 aura and 50–100 magicules. Chained is granted at birth and retained through evolution; starting aura is not multiplied.

sections.title: Evolution requirements
lines: Tempered Vessel: 100,000 total EP; 1 mastered Battlewills; Chained 20%.
Unshackled: 500,000 total EP; 2 mastered Battlewills; Chained 40%.
Heavenly Restricted: 2,000,000 total EP; 3 mastered Battlewills; Chained 60%.
Heavenbreaker: 8,000,000 total EP; 4 mastered Battlewills; Chained 100%.

sections.title: Progression
lines: Use Tensura’s race evolution menu. EP requirements check the total shown in Status. Hunter’s Recovery is granted at Unshackled; Apex Renewal at Heavenly Restricted; Sovereign Rebirth at Heavenbreaker.

sections.title: Racial health bonuses
lines: Tempered Vessel: +100 HP / +400 SHP. Unshackled: +300 HP / +1,600 SHP.
Heavenly Restricted: +600 HP / +3,600 SHP. Heavenbreaker: +1,000 HP / +6,600 SHP. Each stage replaces the old racial bonuses.

sections.title: Starting skill rolls
lines: Skills with magicule-cost abilities or target-skill stealing/copying are excluded from Fettered Human’s starting rolls. Pride is exempt; Creator and recorded derived skills remain allowed.

entries.title: Chained
entries.summary: The lineage’s Unique Skill trades magical growth and unrestricted learning for aura and physical combat.

sections.title: Always active while owned
lines: Later maximum-aura gains receive 5× growth; existing magicule capacity is retained but cannot grow. EP gains split 90% aura / 10% magicules; the blocked magicule share is not redirected.
Retain up to 1 magicule per second and convert the remaining computed regeneration, including biome and sleep bonuses, into aura.

Learn Battlewills, resistances/nullifications, reincarnation skills and their derived skills, and lineage recovery skills. Blocked skills remain visible but cannot finish learning. Resistances use their configured acquisition cost in current aura.

sections.title: Toggle: Martial Supremacy
lines: Battlewill learning/mastery +9; resistance learning +19. Battlewill-sourced attacks deal 5× damage; other Physical hits deal 3×. These branches do not stack. Numeric Battlewill buffs receive 3× effectiveness; Aura Sword is excluded.

sections.title: Mastered: Broken Limit
lines: Always active when mastered. Your hits ignore dodge and lower Nullification to Resistance, and Resistance to nothing.

sections.title: In slot: Unerring Body
lines: 10% damage reduction, 100% projectile dodge and 25% other dodge, subject to native bypass rules. Immune to Fear, Slowness, Burden and Haki effects.

sections.title: Press: Severance Rush
lines: Aim and teleport up to 16 blocks, including in the air; stop before the aimed enemy. Physical damage along a 3-block radius and at the 4-block arrival. Cost: 2% current aura. Cooldown: 1 second.
Base damage: path 1.5 × √A + W; arrival 3 × √A + W. A is the base aura payment; W is the held weapon contribution. Weapon enchantments and engravings apply.

entries.title: Unbound
entries.summary: Chained automatically evolves into this Ultimate when you are Heavenbreaker, fully master Chained, and become a True Hero or True Demon Lord.

sections.title: Retained pact
lines: Retains Chained’s restrictions, aura growth and regeneration conversion. Presets and progress carry over.

sections.title: Improved combat
lines: Toggle: 8× Battlewill damage or 5× other Physical damage; 4× numeric Battlewill buffs except Aura Sword. The damage branches remain separate.
In slot: 30% damage reduction, 100% projectile dodge and 50% other dodge. Retains Fear, Slowness, Burden and Haki immunity.
Mastered Broken Limit retains resistance degradation and dodge bypass, and makes your attacks critical hits.

sections.title: Severance Rush
lines: The same 16-block aim teleport and Physical path/arrival formulas as Chained. Cost: 2% current aura. Cooldown: 1 second. Held weapon effects apply.

sections.title: Counter
lines: Press to hold a defensive stance for 3 seconds with movement speed 0. The first eligible enemy hit is negated and releases a terrain-piercing slash toward the attacker, hitting other enemies along its path.
Cost: 10% current aura on entry. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Press again to cancel early for free.
Physical base damage: 10 × negated damage + 6 × √A + W. The released weapon’s damage, enchantments and engravings apply; toggle bonuses and critical hits then apply.

entries.title: Schema
entries.summary: Obtain Schema from Tensura’s Battlewill Manual random pool. Learn: 1,000 points. Master: 2,000 points. It no longer appears automatically.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press Build to open the tree. Choose Add Mito, Add Str. or Add Regen; select a slot to move or remove it. Apply saves; Close discards unapplied edits. Toggle Schema to activate the saved tree.

sections.title: Effects per stack
lines: Mitochondrial: +500% aura regeneration; −5% outgoing damage.
Strength: +5 base attack damage; +2% damage taken.
Regenerative: +20% HP/SHP healing received; +5% aura and magicule costs. Healing bonuses apply once and respect native limits.

sections.title: Slot order and mastery
lines: Positive weights start at 100%, 50%, 25%, 12.5%, 6.25%, 3.125%. Every 400 mastery makes another slot full strength, reaching all six at 2,000. All effects share that order; drawbacks always stay full strength.
Chained/Unbound boosts positive Battlewill bonuses once; drawbacks are not boosted.

sections.title: Training
lines: Qualifying aura recovery, Strength hits and Regenerative healing share one mastery gain every 30 seconds. Idle full reserves, editing and toggling grant no training. The timer and build persist after saving.

entries.title: Air Walk
entries.summary: A Battlewill evolution of Air Float / Air Flight.

sections.title: Learn
lines: Master your permanent Air Float, then complete the new learning entry in the Battlewill menu.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press to enable free flight using aura. Press again to stop; stopping is free even with empty aura.
Cost: 30 aura to activate and 30 aura per second actually flying. Mastery halves both to 15. No magicule cost or cooldown.

entries.title: Instant Transmission
entries.summary: A Battlewill evolution of Instant Move for coordinate self-teleportation.

sections.title: Learn
lines: Master your permanent Instant Move, then complete its evolution’s learning entry.

sections.title: Use
lines: Press to enter X, Y and Z, then choose Warp. Only you travel, within the current dimension; it does not create portals.
Charge: 100 ticks / 5 seconds; instant at mastery. Cost: 10 aura per block of 3D distance, halved to 5 at mastery. Opening the menu is free.

sections.title: Limits
lines: Native spatial blocks still apply. Invalid or unfunded requests do not start a cast. Losing the skill, dying, logging out or changing dimension cancels a pending cast; a started cast has already paid.

entries.title: Aura recovery skills
entries.summary: Toggle a recovery skill to heal with aura. Only your strongest toggled tier works; full reserves cost nothing.

sections.title: Hunter’s Recovery
lines: Restore 4 HP per second, or 8 mastered, at 20 aura per base HP.

sections.title: Apex Renewal
lines: Restore missing HP every half second. Cost: 30 aura per base HP, or 20 mastered.

sections.title: Sovereign Rebirth
lines: Restore HP and SHP every half second. Cost: 30 aura per HP / 10 per SHP, or 20 / 5 mastered. Can prevent ordinary fatal damage while funded; native bypass and suppression rules still apply.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: Granted by the relevant Heavenly Restriction evolutions. Earlier recovery skills remain available, but do not heal in parallel.

entries.title: Inverted Spear of Heaven
entries.summary: A rare weapon from ominous trial vault loot, with the same attack stats as a Hihiirokane Sword.

sections.title: Stats and obtaining
lines: 80 total ordinary player attack damage; 1.6 attack speed. Rare 2% additional ominous-vault reward. Regular vaults do not drop it.

sections.title: Nullification engraving
lines: Weapon hits instantly shatter barriers, remove skill status effects, and prevent skill activation for 2 seconds. The weapon can attack Spiritual Entities.
Held main-hand attacks, Severance Rush and Counter carry the engraving. Spiritual contact bypasses the spiritual-body Physical reduction, while armor, resistance, dodge and PvP rules still apply.

entries.title: Parallel World Jumper
entries.summary: Unique skill · Single-player travel through a hidden library of up to 128 worlds.

sections.title: World Jump · Active, Press
lines: With no destination selected, every dimension regenerates under a new seed. Your character, inventory and progression carry over. The game saves and reloads. Cooldown: 5 minutes, shared by fresh and return jumps. World Select remains usable during cooldown. No resource cost or damage.

sections.title: World Select · Active, Press · Requires Learning
lines: World Select must be learned separately. Select its mode and press the skill to gain learning points; once learned, pressing it opens the world menu.

Browse previously visited worlds. Search by name or seed, choose a world, then press Set next jump. World Jump travels there once, preserving its terrain, builds and entities while bringing your current character, inventory, skills and progression.
Choose New World and confirm to clear your selection. Selecting a destination does not teleport you. After a jump, the next unselected jump generates a fresh seed again.
Earlier World Hop saves are imported when their recorded previous saves still exist in this instance. Missing saves cannot be selected.

sections.title: Arrival
lines: Land on the nearest safe ground around your previous coordinates. If there is no nearby safe ground, World Hop searches around the Overworld spawn instead.

sections.title: Hidden world library
lines: Only the active save appears in Singleplayer. All visited worlds are stored inside its hidden library and reached through World Select. The limit is 128 worlds, including the active world. At the limit, revisit existing worlds; new-world creation is blocked.

Deleting the active save from Singleplayer deletes the entire hidden library, including its visited worlds and internal recovery copies. Renaming or backing up the whole save keeps the library with it.
Existing recorded travel history is moved into the library on the next jump. Unrelated saves remain separate. Older libraries above 128 retain their worlds but cannot create more.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: Can roll as a reincarnation Unique in a private single-player world. Cannot be acquired, copied, learned or used on dedicated servers or while open to LAN. Chained must receive it through reincarnation to permit it.

entries.title: Fusion
entries.summary: Unique skill · Share a body and skills with a subordinate or consenting player for 3 minutes.

sections.title: Fuse · Active, Press
lines: Aim within 16 blocks at your subordinate or another player. Players must accept the invitation. You control a subordinate’s fused form; a receiving player controls their own fused body.

Fused EP = (your actual max EP + the target’s actual max EP) × 1.5. Aura and magicule capacities keep the participants’ combined resource split. Both resources regenerate 10× faster; final outgoing damage is doubled.

HP and SHP combine by addition: maximum HP/SHP and the remaining HP/SHP are each summed. The EP multiplier does not multiply HP or SHP. Native skill menus show the borrowed abilities in their normal categories; use f:temporary to find temporary entries.

The fused body temporarily has the participants’ skills. Existing learned skills are retained. Borrowed skills and their storage/cooldown state return to their owner after separation; normal acquisition and activation restrictions apply.
Duration: 3 minutes. Press Fuse again or choose Separate Fusion in the pause menu to end early. The absorbed caster can also sneak to separate. No resource cost or additional cooldown.

sections.title: Separation
lines: Both participants receive Paralysis II and Fragility II for 5 minutes, including after early separation. Their original EP, forms and permanent skills return.
Remaining resources are divided proportionally; fusing cannot refill either participant for free. Death, disconnect, dimension change or server shutdown ends Fusion. Fusion cannot be nested.

sections.title: Damage type
lines: Fuse has no direct attack damage. The ×2 multiplier retains each attack’s original damage type, including Physical, magical and direct Spiritual damage.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: Available in normal Unique reincarnation rolls. Excluded from Fettered Human’s roll pool because it borrows target skills.

sections.title: Mastery
lines: Fuse lasts 4 minutes 30 seconds and multiplies combined EP by 1.75 instead of 1.5. Mastery is checked on the caster when fusion begins. HP/SHP still add normally; regeneration, damage and separation penalties retain their normal values.

entries.title: Prospector
entries.summary: Mine faster, gain extra Fortune, sense ores and use native refining.

sections.title: Passive · Toggle
lines: Mining speed +50%. Fortune +3, added to the tool's existing level; Fortune III becomes effective Fortune VI. The tool is unchanged, and Silk Touch keeps its normal behavior.
Correctly mining stone or deepslate has a 1% chance to find one extra resource. Common resources are more likely than rare gems; magic ore shards can appear.
Sense loaded ore deposits through terrain within 32 blocks. Faint markers use distinct colors and glyphs, without an ore-name text box. Toggle off to hide them.

sections.title: Refine · Active, Press
lines: Open Tensura's normal refining menu. Use its existing recipes: base inputs go in the three left slots; reagents go in the five middle slots.
Use the native Refine/Repeat buttons. Ingredients and output remain stored when the menu closes. Refine works with the passive off.

sections.title: Obtaining and cost
lines: Unique skill in the normal reincarnation pool. Eligible for Fettered Human's roll. No aura or magicule activation/upkeep cost. Damage type: None.

sections.title: Mastery
lines: Stone/deepslate finds increase from 1% to 1.5%. Among successful finds, diamond rises from 2% to 7%, emerald from 1% to 4% and magic ore shard from 3% to 7%; uncommon materials also receive more weight. The passive must be enabled.

entries.title: Exponentiation
entries.summary: Unique · In-slot passive. Raise supported beneficial values to ^1.2; movement is excluded.

sections.title: Use
lines: Learn Exponentiation and equip it in the current Tensura skill preset. No toggle, resource cost or cooldown. Owning it or putting it in an inactive preset does not activate it.

sections.title: Affected
lines: Final outgoing HP/SHP damage; HP/SHP healing; aura and magicule recovery; resource recovery; total kill EP awards before the normal race split; learning and mastery gains; XP and block/mob drop stack quantities.

Beneficial attributes: non-energy capacities, attack damage and speed, mining and chant speed, armor, barriers, elemental boosts/resistances, chances, senses, reach and other supported non-movement attributes.

sections.title: Rules and limits
lines: Each output is raised to ^1.2 once. Formula inputs are read normally while calculating damage, recovery, mining and point gains. Saved base stats are not repeatedly exponentiated. Maximum HP, SHP, absorption, oxygen and water/lava capacities are raised to ^1.2; maximum aura and magicules stay normal. Maximum air supply uses seconds before the ^1.2 bonus: 15 seconds becomes about 25.75 seconds (515 ticks), without an instant refill.

Values of 1 or less are retained so fractions are not weakened. Chances stop at their native maximum; drops stop at each item’s normal stack size; finite number limits apply. Chained’s locked magicule cap remains locked.

sections.title: Excluded
lines: All movement: running, flying, swimming, sneaking, jumping, dashes, teleports, knockback and body size. Attack speed, mining speed and chant speed ARE included.

No power bonus to costs, cooldowns, incoming damage, progression requirements, recipe outputs, enchantment levels or fixed skill constants such as duration/radius. The web wiki lists exact native attribute IDs.

entries.title: Loan Shark
entries.summary: Unique · Lend skill copies with retained mastery. Transfer 25% of EP gains, stacking with diminishing returns for additional active gifts.

sections.title: Loan
lines: Loan and Report are separate native skill modes: scroll the assigned skill slot to switch. Loan opens the learned-skill picker for your aimed subordinate or player within 16 blocks; Report opens only your ledger. The menus have no tabs. Only fully learned permanent lendable skills appear. Players must accept gifts; subordinate gifts are immediate.

Copies retain mastery, learned mode progress and current cooldowns. They do not clone stored inventories/banks or active effects. Already-owned skills cannot be overwritten; temporary/sub-abilities and Loan Shark itself cannot be lent.

sections.title: Income and usage
lines: Active gifts transfer 25% of new permanent EP for one gift, 43.75% for two, 57.8125% for three and 68.359375% for four. Each additional gift takes 25% of the remaining gain; the total approaches 100% without exceeding it. Count only gifts in use on that borrower; share the total equally among active gifts, including different lenders. Current-resource regeneration is not EP. Offline lenders receive queued credit on return.

Casting/channeling and attributed hits count as use; toggles count while enabled, native ticking passives while ticking, and detected in-slot passives while equipped. Resistances are continuously active while owned. Brief casts/hits use a one-second activity window.

sections.title: Report and Claim
lines: Report lists outstanding gifts. Claimed/recalled gifts and confirmed dead-subordinate loans leave the list. Unloading and player respawn preserve loans. Close record cancels an unavailable loan without an extra skill; its gift is recalled if the borrower returns. Confirmation stays available during refreshes.

Claim always recalls the gifted copy. After at least 10 uninterrupted minutes idle, and only if still idle, it also grants a random eligible unowned skill with retained mastery. With skillSteal true it removes the original from the borrower; with skillSteal false it copies the skill and leaves their original intact. Chained and every Ultimate-classified skill are excluded in both modes.
Claim sooner or while active only recalls the copy. A closed contract cannot be claimed twice. Existing independent skill ownership is protected.

sections.title: Mastery
lines: Claim can grant an extra skill after 8 uninterrupted minutes idle instead of 10. The gifted skill must still be idle when claimed; all eligibility and skillSteal rules still apply.

entries.title: The High Realm
entries.summary: Late-game dimension. Requires 5,000,000 actual maximum EP to enter; return travel has no EP requirement.

sections.title: Build the gate
lines: Build a vertical 5-wide, 6-tall frame with an empty 3 × 4 opening. Place Netherite Blocks at all four corners, a Lodestone at bottom center, and an Amethyst Block at top center. Fill the other twelve frame positions with Crying Obsidian. Either horizontal orientation works.

Use one Nether Star on the Lodestone to awaken the gate. The star is consumed once in survival. Stand inside for 2 seconds, or use the awakened Lodestone, to enter. Each entering player must meet the EP requirement; EP is not spent.

sections.title: Explore
lines: Ivory Crags: High Orcs, Armorsauruses, Horned Bears and Greater Daemons. Starwood Grove: Tempest Star Wolves, Blade Tigers and Knight Spiders. Mistglass Basin: Dragonewts, Basilisks and Arch Daemons. The ordinary elite pool stays entirely Tensura mobs; Kael uses a separate rare boss spawn rule. Half of otherwise valid natural spawn attempts are accepted, with at most 16 living unowned elites within 64 blocks of a new spawn. Existing mobs remain.

Elites retain native models, animations and combat AI, with 1.25–2.5 million base EP and 11–17 core mastered skills. Every species has a mastered Unique Skill: High Orc—Berserker, Armorsaurus/Basilisk—Survivor, Horned Bear—Fighter, Tempest Star Wolf—Shadow Striker, Blade Tiger—Seer, Knight Spider—Oppressor, Dragonewt—Martial Master, Greater Daemon—Engorger, Arch Daemon—Mathematician. Their usable passives are enabled and required skill slots are equipped. All retain themed defenses, sensing, regeneration and damage boosts.

Orcs use their highest non-boss naming evolution; wolves use the final Tempest Star Wolf branch; Lizardmen evolve into Dragonewts with native flight and dragon abilities. The remaining creatures already use their highest implemented non-boss mob forms. Orc Lord/Disaster are excluded as bosses.

Greater Daemons cast Fire Lance, Acid Shell, Icicle Lance, Tornado Blade, Thunder Orb, Stone Shot and Sleep Mist. Arch Daemons cast Fire Ball, Acid Shell, Ice Breaker, Tornado Blade, Water Jail, Mud Spears, Stone Shot and Thunder Orb, using their native AI and casting effects.

Armorsauruses nullify Physical attacks; Orcs/Horned Bears nullify Pain; Direwolves nullify Electricity; Blade Tigers nullify Wind; Lizardmen nullify Water; Knight Spiders/Basilisks nullify Poison. Basilisks also nullify Paralysis. Both daemons nullify Flame, and Arch Daemons also nullify Electricity. Native lower-tier defense entries may remain; nullifications provide the higher defense.
Find native magic ore, emeralds and rare diamonds in the pale stone. Elite kills retain normal loot and EP and add amethyst, with occasional magic ore or rare Netherite Scrap.

Existing eligible unowned Orcs, wolves and Lizardmen advance when loaded without refilling resources. Saved unowned elites receive the halved EP balance once; HP, SHP and skill packages are unchanged. Owned mobs remain unchanged. Old daemon entity types remain until normal despawning; new spawns use the upgraded pool.

sections.title: Return safely
lines: The quartz return arch at the arrival sanctum is your return gate. Walk through it or use its central bedrock base to leave; leaving never requires EP. Return locations are saved separately for each player.
The arrival sanctum is protected from normal block edits and suppresses natural spawns within 48 blocks. Avoid using beds in this dimension. The surrounding terrain is editable.

Gates, terrain and return locations persist across restarts. World Hop generates a fresh High Realm per new world; revisiting a saved world restores its realm. The server can configure entry EP, gate charge time, elite strength, spawn chance and the local elite cap. Existing worlds using the old 10M default are upgraded once to 5M; other custom thresholds are retained.

sections.title: Kael Veyr · Rare otherworlder boss
lines: Rare Divine Human / True Hero, capped at 15M actual EP even after kills. Default native bonuses give 10,000 HP and 37,100 SHP; only HP has a boss bar. He uses Vesper, Martial Master, Mathematician, Seer, Aura Slash and wind magic. He opens fights with Magic Wind Transform. Law Manipulation cleanses harmful effects and takes over enemy magic when valid. Divine Ki Release, Eye of Truth and Unpredictability are mastered and active. Wind Domination supplies passive bonuses only. Infinite Regeneration restores HP/SHP with magicules. Native skill costs, cooldowns and seals apply.

Natural spawning uses weight 1 and a 2.5% acceptance roll, with a 20-minute realm-wide cooldown, no other wild Kael within 512 blocks, and no spawning within 192 blocks of the return sanctum. The cooldown permits future rolls, not a guaranteed spawn. Loot includes Vesper, a Starless Core, Hihiirokane Ingots, Magic Ore, Echo Shards and Netherite Scrap.

entries.title: Split Mind
entries.summary: Unique skill: parallel thought, faster learning and automatic native magic casting.

sections.title: Passive toggle
lines: Gain +9 learning point gain and +9 mastery point gain. Gain native Thought Acceleration and Chant Annulment. Mastered magic casts instantly; unmastered magic retains its accelerated casting time. This passive does not need a skill slot.

sections.title: Magic Assignment · Press
lines: Open a searchable menu of your fully learned aspectual and spiritual magics. Filter by type, select a spell, choose an unlocked mode from its Mode dropdown, then press Assign magic. Assignments persist; unlearned entries and spells you do not own cannot be assigned. Clear removes the assignment and stops Auto-Cast.

sections.title: Auto-Cast · Press to toggle
lines: Automatically cast the assigned magic at the nearest visible hostile mob or combat opponent within 32 blocks. Allies, owned creatures, passive bystanders and protected players are excluded. Combat opponents can include players when PvP permits.

Normal magic costs, cooldowns, cast times and activation restrictions apply. Checks for a new cast every 5 ticks; held spells finish their normal cast. Uses the selected mode’s native damage, costs and cooldown. Repeat/held modes continue at their native cadence while a valid target remains. Self/buff spells retain their native behavior. Auto-Cast does not turn or zoom your camera or apply casting slowdown. Different manually cast spells can run at the same time; manual use of the assigned spell takes priority because its cooldown and casting state are shared. This switch is independent of the passive toggle.
No extra Split Mind resource cost. Not rolled for Fettered Human because Auto-Cast uses magicule-cost abilities; the normal server allowlist can override that rule.

sections.title: Mastery
lines: Auto-Cast costs 25% fewer magicules, including repeat/held pulses. Aura costs and manual magic costs stay unchanged. The Magic Assignment menu shows the discounted magicule cost.

entries.title: Marauder's Map
entries.summary: Unique · A dimension atlas with shared exploration, structures, live players and private pins.

sections.title: Open Map · Active, Press
lines: Slot the learned Unique in Tensura’s normal menu and activate Open Map. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, and press Home or the compass button to return to your location. No resource cost or cooldown.

Click a marker on the map or in the list for its actions. Right-click empty map space and choose Add pin here…. Layers controls structures, pins and players. Map tools has Go to coordinates… and the map guide.

sections.title: Dimensions and shared exploration
lines: The grass, crimson nylium and end-stone tabs show the Overworld, Nether and End. Hover for their names. The eye tab opens a searchable Other dimensions dropdown. Each dimension remembers its map position and zoom; changing tabs never moves your character.

Terrain explored by any online player is recorded on the server and shared, even if they do not own this skill. Actual explored surfaces and builds appear for everyone. Recording begins with this version and refreshes over time without forcing terrain loads. Custom pins remain private.

sections.title: Terrain and structures
lines: Pan anywhere, including unloaded terrain. A crisp biome overview appears first, followed by relief. Unexplored terrain is a generation preview; zoom in for native block detail. Recorded surfaces stay detailed when zoomed out. Reopening reuses recently viewed terrain. Nether views look below the roof.

With Structures enabled under Layers, vanilla and addon markers appear as they are discovered at every zoom, including unexplored regions. Overlapping views reuse completed discovery. World-generation locations become confirmed when their structure generates. Dense sites cluster with counts; zoom in to separate them.

Locate structure… searches up to 100,000 blocks around the viewed map center. The map centers on a result automatically. Escape cancels a search. Structures OFF pauses automatic discovery. Player-built landmarks use custom pins.

Locate structure… lists every registered structure. Name A–Z sorts alphabetically; Mod A–Z groups by mod and sorts names inside each group. Entries show their mod and full IDs on hover. Search narrows names, mods and IDs as you type. Scroll or drag the scrollbar, select an entry and press Start search.

sections.title: Travel and players
lines: Select a structure in your current dimension and choose Travel… in its actions. Choose a learned usable coordinate-teleport skill. The site is verified first; missing locations are removed from the map. Its native menu opens with a safe surface arrival prefilled. Confirm Warp to teleport with that skill’s normal costs and restrictions. Merely browsing another dimension never grants cross-dimension travel.

All online player locations refresh twice per second, including players beyond render distance. Your arrow is gold; other players are cyan. Focus on map in a player’s actions switches to their dimension and centers on them. Offline players disappear.

sections.title: Custom pins
lines: Right-click the map and choose Add pin here…, or press N for the map center. Set a name, X/Y/Z, one of eight colors and one of six icons. Select an existing pin to Focus, Edit or Delete it. Deletion requires confirmation.
Up to 256 private pins per player across dimensions. Only the viewed dimension’s pins appear. Pins survive reconnects and remain invisible to other players.

entries.title: Chromatic Orb
entries.summary: One-time anvil enhancement: +1 to all eligible engraving levels, beyond normal limits.

sections.title: Craft
lines: Combine one Bulwark Shard, one Sentinel Shard, one Skirmisher Shard and one Starless Core in any crafting arrangement. Makes one orb.

Matching unowned High Realm elites have a 25% chance to drop their archetype shard after a player or subordinate kill. Kael drops one Starless Core. Ordinary mobs and owned subordinates do not drop shards.

sections.title: Use
lines: Put equipment in the left anvil slot and an orb in the right slot. Taking the result consumes one orb and one XP level.
Every eligible engraving gains one level, even beyond its normal maximum. Curses, blessings and ordinary enchantments stay unchanged. At least one eligible engraving is required.
Once per equipment piece. The tooltip marks an applied infusion; repairs, renaming, grinding, smithing and normal gear evolution retain that history. Grinding still removes engravings normally.

sections.title: Upgrade examples
lines: Crushing I → II: weapon bonus 50% → 100%, mining efficiency 5 → 8, and extra durability damage per attack 5 → 10.

Magic Capacity III → IV adds a fourth stored-magic slot. Magicule Absorption II → III adds +3 instead of +2 to magicule regeneration; with base 1 and no other bonuses, total regeneration is 4× instead of 3×.
Severance I → II raises flat attack damage from +3 to +6, but the anti-healing wound fraction stays capped at 50%.

sections.title: Native limits
lines: Breathing Support II and Nullification II have the same functional effects as level I. Nullification still seals skills for 2 seconds. Mysticism’s Boreal Frost II also keeps its original duration and amplifier.
Slotting IV can hold four cores, but the supported native versions have no four-core combination recipes. A supported recipe is required for a core-combination attack or cast.
Blessings of Vitality, Vigor, Transcendence, Growth and Restoration stay unchanged, as do curses, Tsukumogami and ordinary enchantments.

entries.title: Vesper
entries.summary: Kael’s unique sword. Wind hits empower a delayed follow-up cut.

sections.title: Obtaining and stats
lines: Kael Veyr wields Vesper and drops one with Afterwind I. Baseline attack damage: 105 with 1 base attack. Attack speed: 1.7; extra reach: 1 block. Durability: 3,960; repair with Hihiirokane Ingots.

sections.title: Afterwind
lines: While holding Vesper, successfully dealing Wind damage marks that enemy for 5 seconds. Your next direct sword strike on that enemy releases a Wind cut after 0.2 seconds. The cut deals 30% of your raw attack attribute, with normal Wind bonuses and defenses.
One cut per wielder every 3 seconds. Marks do not stack. Switching away, death or changing dimension cancels the pending cut. The enemy must remain within 12 blocks.
Damage types: Physical for ordinary sword hits; Wind elemental for Afterwind. No extra resource cost.
Damage recorded by Tensura training dummies also counts, even though their HP stays full.

sections.title: Chromatic Orb
lines: One Chromatic Orb can raise Afterwind to level II: the raw-attack coefficient increases from 30% to 75%. Cooldown, delay and mark duration stay the same.

entries.title: Critical Merchant
entries.summary: Unique · Compound critical damage and prepare ten guaranteed critical hits.

sections.title: Compound Interest · Passive toggle
lines: Every critical hit gets a guaranteed ×1.5 damage bonus. Each successful 50% roll multiplies that bonus by ×1.25. Stop at the first failure or 100 successes. Each critical starts a fresh chain; there is no separate payout cap.

Before defenses, a 100-damage critical becomes 150, then 187.5 after one success, then 234.375 after two. The bonus is 1.5 × 1.25^successes. Original damage types, armor, resistances and barriers still apply.

sections.title: Guaranteed Profit · Active press
lines: Cost: 1,000 magicules. Cooldown: 20 seconds. Your next 10 landed hits are guaranteed critical hits, including owned projectiles and abilities. Misses, blocked hits and immune targets do not spend a hit. Training-dummy damage counts.

The active works independently of the passive. Toggle Compound Interest on to amplify the guaranteed criticals. Recasting refreshes the count to 10, never stacks it; the skill mode shows the remaining count. Guarantees clear on death or forgetting the skill.

sections.title: Obtaining
lines: A rollable Unique Skill in Tensura’s normal Unique pool, subject to server reincarnation settings. Fettered Human excludes it because Guaranteed Profit costs magicules.
Damage type: the original attack’s type. Guaranteed Profit itself deals no damage.

entries.title: Hephaestus, Lord of the Forge
entries.summary: Ultimate · Combine Prospector and Godly Craftsman to forge exceptional equipment and command a living arsenal.

sections.title: Synthesis
lines: Fully master Prospector and Godly Craftsman, become a True Demon Lord or True Hero, and personally craft or smith Netherite or Hihiirokane equipment. No EP requirement. Activate the unfinished entry in the native Ultimate menu to view requirements and confirm synthesis.

The default acquisition cost is 250,000 permanent magicules, configurable and affected by Tensura’s skill-cost gamerule. Awakening bonuses apply first. Hephaestus replaces its components and starts learned, unmastered; stored items, engraving knowledge and affected presets are retained.

sections.title: Master of the Crucible · Passive toggle
lines: +100% mining speed, stacking Fortune V, 3% material finds from stone/deepslate and differentiated ore sight within 32 blocks.

Personally forged equipment gains +20% attack damage / armor / toughness and 50% reduced durability damage. Bonuses apply once per item. Both ordinary and EP wear are reduced; maximum durability is unchanged. While toggled on, prevent new curses from equipment EP growth and engraving rolls on weapons, armor, tools and other equipment. Existing curses remain; Tsukumogami generation is unchanged. Damage type: original equipment type.

sections.title: Divine Forge · Active press
lines: In Forge, select equipment, choose an action and material, and press the gold action button. Utilities opens crafting, native refining and engraving, storage and ingredient recovery. Forging bonuses also apply at Tensura’s Smithing Bench, including shift-click results. Reforge can apply the bonus to older equipment. Recover returns your old Prospector refining ingredients. Lord of the Forge may research overcap engravings; applying an Orb-eligible overcap marks the receiving item’s Orb upgrade as spent. Godly Craftsman cannot research overcap engravings, and its old stored overcaps normalize to ordinary maxima. Normal capped engravings retain the Orb upgrade.

Reforge / Temper: 2,000 magicules + one material. Iron / Diamond / Netherite / Hihiirokane give 10% / 20% / 30% / 35% temper strength. Keen improves critical damage; Piercing ignores part of armor reduction. On weapons Conductor improves elemental damage; on worn armor it reduces elemental damage taken, including SHP hits. Enduring reduces item wear. Each temper has one effect per item. Armor slots contribute 15% head, 40% chest, 30% legs and 15% feet of the material strength; full sets contribute up to 35%, with offensive bonuses added to the weapon. Enduring instead applies its full strength to that piece’s wear.
Repair: 500 magicules + one material; restores 30% / 60% / 90% / 100% ordinary and native EP durability. Engravings and Chromatic Orb history remain. Damage type: none directly.

sections.title: Living Arsenal · Active press
lines: Deploy up to six actual melee weapons. They hover in formation and slash with curved lunges and prismatic wakes, like Terraprisma. They prioritize your attack target, then visible hostiles or combat opponents within 32 blocks, respecting alliances and PvP rules.

Cost: 1,000 magicules per deployed weapon and 10 per weapon each second. Each uses its own damage, enchantments and engravings. Eligible deployed weapons gain EP from your qualifying kills using native growth rates, engraving bonuses, caps and evolutions; recall preserves the growth. Check inventory weapons on the left of Arsenal and deploy the selected group. The six-slot rack on the right shows deployed blades; click a blade to recall it. Add weapons while the arsenal is active. All swords take turns in one 24-tick round. Press again to manage; shift-press or use Recall all to return everything. Death, logout, dimension changes or losing the skill also recall them; saved escrow survives a restart. Damage type: Physical, with normal native conversions / engraving follow-ups.

sections.title: Magnum Opus · Active press
lines: Designate one personally forged item: +50% equipment stats and 75% reduced wear replace the ordinary forging benefits. Cost: 50,000 magicules + two selected materials, Diamond or better.

Changing designation removes the old masterpiece’s special bonus, even outside loaded inventories. It keeps its ordinary forged benefits. The active piece has a glint, gold identification and a golden arsenal wake. No Overforge. Damage type: none directly.

entries.title: Metis, Lord of Wisdom
entries.summary: Ultimate · Split Mind + Great Sage · Parallel spell matrix and automatic circle analysis.

sections.title: Synthesis
lines: Fully master Split Mind and Great Sage, complete True Demon Lord/True Hero awakening, and learn three distinct aspectual/spiritual magics. Open the unfinished Metis entry in Skills → Ultimate and confirm synthesis. No EP requirement.

Default cost: 250,000 permanent magicules, configurable and affected by mpSkillCost. Awakening bonuses apply first. Stored items, the Split Mind assignment and affected presets survive. Autonomous Sage starts disabled.

sections.title: Unified Intellect · Passive toggle
lines: Chant Annulment, Thought Acceleration and +19 learning/mastery points. Automatically analyze visible magic circles within 32 blocks using normal native copy/acquisition rules; skip your own circles and already learned spells. Record combat opponents’ elemental defenses. Damage type: none.

sections.title: Parallel Matrix · Active press
lines: Assign three learned active abilities, or four when mastered: aspectual/spiritual magic, skills and arts. Choose a thread, ability, learned mode, scheduling priority and offensive target preference. One thread per ability. Filter, search and scroll the learned-only list. Menu-opening modes are excluded. Damage type: none directly.

sections.title: Autonomous Sage · Active toggle
lines: Run assigned abilities while fighting and casting manually. Healing is self-directed below 90% HP; support skips redundant buffs. Offense targets hostile mobs/combat opponents within 32 blocks, respecting alliances, PvP and line of sight. Manual use of the same ability takes priority.

Automatic aspectual/spiritual spells cost 30% fewer magicules; mastery raises the reduction to 40%. Native aura costs, cooldowns, anti-magic and casting rules remain. Damage type: assigned ability’s native type.

Background casting does not swing your arm. Direct automatic spells have independent hurt windows. Distinct native magic projectiles also land independently, including manual casts. Repeated pulses from one persistent source retain native timing; ordinary weapon damage and defensive invulnerability remain separate.

sections.title: Optimal Solution · Passive toggle
lines: For assigned offensive aspectual/spiritual magic, skip active nullifications and prioritize elemental effectiveness within scheduling bands while Unified Intellect is active. Skill/art damage types are not guessed. Does not suppress defenses. Damage type: none.

sections.title: Inherited utilities
lines: Analytical Appraisal: level 20, or 40 mastered; native toggle/filter and +15/+25 appraisal distance bonus. Analysis: guaranteed eligible unowned copies, including resistances/nullifications, subject to native protections. Unique/Ultimate and temporary skills remain excluded; the target keeps their skill. Native ranges: 10 blocks for living targets, 30 for eligible magic projectiles. Success cooldown: 5 seconds, or 2 mastered; unavailable attempts: 1 second. Levels and success cooldowns are configurable. Refine / Craft opens repeat crafting; shift-press opens native refining. Both use the preserved shared container. Damage type: none directly.

sections.title: Skill and art assignment
lines: Use All / Aspectual / Spiritual / Skills / Arts to filter learned abilities. Assign one learned mode per thread. Menu-opening modes are omitted and rejected again by the server; for example Spatial Motion Blink is allowed, while its Warp menu, Great Sage crafting/refining and Prospector refining are not.

Skills and arts keep their normal resource costs and cooldowns; Metis’s 30%/40% magicule discount applies to aspectual/spiritual magic. Main activations are used, without shift-menu shortcuts. Passive-only abilities, automation controllers, world jumping and copied-technique containers are excluded.

sections.title: Automatic cleansing
lines: At full HP or while injured: Antidote treats Poison, Nausea and Weakness; mastered Antidote also reduces Fatal Poison. Healer Heal treats Infection and heals below 90% HP (also SHP at mastery). Chef treats Severance, permitted harmful effects, or low HP; Lust Invigorate treats permitted harmful effects or low HP. Neither cleanses protected skill effects.

Empty-hand Isolation treats Severance or harmful effects. Law Manipulation Abnormality Cleanse treats Severance, Cook’s HP reduction, Magic Interference and effects in its native cleansing tag. Learned Spatial Cleanse treats Severance only. Reverser Inverted Fusion [Buff] treats harmful effects outside the skill-debuff tag, excluding Magicule Poison; at mastery it requires an empty hand for automatic use.

Normal costs, cooldowns and activation protections remain. Native tags can be changed by datapacks. Invigorate also removes unprotected beneficial effects when cast; those alone never trigger it. Metis rechecks conditions before casting and skips a cleanse when another thread has already cured the status.

entries.title: Elias and the Archive of Accord
entries.summary: One permanent Unique Skill lesson per player, in a rare Overworld library.

sections.title: Find the Archivist
lines: Rare Archives of Accord generate in suitable Overworld forests, plains, meadows and savannas. Look in newly generated chunks. Marauder’s Map can locate heavenlyrestriction:mentor_archive; administrators can use /locate structure heavenlyrestriction:mentor_archive. Look for its slate gable, copper-crowned tower and reading gallery. Elias is protected and stays inside the library.

sections.title: One extraordinary lesson
lines: Interact with Elias, search the Unique Skill catalogue, select a skill, then confirm Learn this skill. Default price: 1,000,000 permanent EP and one Chromatic Orb. The learned skill is permanent and starts unmastered. There is no additional native magicule acquisition charge.

The EP cost removes permanent aura/magicule capacity proportionally to your existing reserves; equipment and temporary bonuses cannot fund it. You must retain some permanent EP afterward. The price is configurable.

sections.title: A permanent choice
lines: Only one successful purchase per player across all archives. Death, reincarnation, losing the skill and World Jump do not restore the lesson. Unaffordable, blocked and canceled purchases consume nothing.

The catalogue includes eligible Unique skills from Tensura and installed addons. Already learned skills cannot be purchased. Chained’s restrictions and native unlock protections still apply. Anti-Skill and Chained are excluded; Parallel World Jumper is available only in supported private single-player. No Ultimate or Godly skills. Server datapacks can extend heavenlyrestriction:mentor_excluded.

entries.title: Tyche, Lord of Fortune
entries.summary: Ultimate · Critical Merchant + Tuner · Critical odds and survival.

sections.title: Synthesis
lines: Master Critical Merchant and Tuner, complete True Hero/True Demon Lord awakening, land 50 compounded critical hits and survive three distinct damage types with Tuner. Open Tyche’s unfinished Ultimate entry and confirm synthesis. No EP gate. Default cost: 250,000 permanent magicules, paid after awakening bonuses; configurable and affected by mpSkillCost.

sections.title: Loaded Dice / Against All Odds · Passive toggle
lines: Critical hits start at ×2; each successful 50% roll multiplies that bonus by ×1.35. Reroll the first failure once; the next failure stops the chain. Maximum: 100 successes, with no separate payout cap. Bonus = 2 × 1.35^successes. Attacks keep their original damage type.

At or below 50% HP or SHP, gain the full buff for 20 seconds with a 60-second cooldown from activation. +50% attack damage, +25 melee/projectile evasion points. Attack/swim-speed bonuses are 50% stronger than mastered Tuner, and movement bonus only 10% stronger, using the server’s Tuner settings. Each category applies once; no duplicate flat attack/evasion layer. Healing does not cancel the buff. Toggling off cancels it but retains cooldown. Timings are configurable.

sections.title: Fate Insurance · Passive true
lines: Survive an eligible fatal hit; recover full current-maximum HP, SHP, magicules and aura, remove harmful effects and reset all other native skill/ability cooldowns. Each damage type triggers once in the same five-minute window, beginning with the first revival. New types can still trigger during that window; they do not extend it. Fate Insurance’s own timer and history are preserved. Native Tuner bypass exceptions apply.

sections.title: Guaranteed Dividend · Active press
lines: Spend 5,000 magicules for ten guaranteed critical hits. Each uses the higher of two Loaded Dice chains. Cooldown: 20 seconds. Recasting refreshes to ten. Blocked/immune hits refund the guarantee. Shift-press opens synthesis or damage-history information.
